purpose_context: Epic #186 reads every Charter Pack file into the domain and writes it back. Issue #188 records the operator's rulings (unknown fields refused, equality by meaning, inconsistencies fixed in the packs, canonical DRG edges) in a new ADR that defines, per file kind, what the round trip compares, how an unknown field is refused, and how a pack inconsistency is filed against spec-kitty-open-packs. #187 and #189 build on it.
purpose_tldr: Decide what 'the same pack after a round trip' means, so the round-trip gate and the whole-pack seam can be built without re-deciding it.
